license_required.quote: A license is required for an individual to engage in the practice of public accounting

issuing_authority.quote: The division shall issue to an individual who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of Certified Public Accountant

name.quote: Board means the Utah Board of Accountancy created in Section 58-26a-201

type.quote: Board means the Utah Board of Accountancy created in Section 58-26a-201

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Licensing, Department of Commerce
umbrella_agency.quote: The division shall administer and enforce all licensing laws of Title 58, Occupations and Professions

degree_required.value: bachelor's degree or master's degree with concentration in accounting and business
degree_required.quote: successful completion of a bachelor's degree, master's degree, or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business at a college or university approved by the board

required.quote: submit evidence of accounting experience in a form the division approves by rule of at least: one year of accounting experience for an individual with a master's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business; or two years of accounting experience for an individual with a bachelor's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business

duration.quote: one year of accounting experience for an individual with a master's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business; or two years of accounting experience for an individual with a bachelor's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business

kind.quote: Accounting experience means applying accounting and auditing skills and principles that are taught as a part of the professional education qualifying a person for licensure under this chapter and generally accepted by the profession, under the supervision of a licensed certified public accountant

exams.name: AICPA Uniform CPA Examination
exams.quote: A person must sit for and meet the conditioning requirements of the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination as established by the AICPA

exams.name: AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs
exams.quote: the AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs

exams.name: Utah Laws and Rules Examination
exams.quote: the Utah Laws and Rules Examination

interval_years.quote: The division shall issue each license and registration under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule

required.quote: as a condition precedent for a license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule

hours_per_period.quote: complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule

period_years.quote: during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education

value: 1 hour on Utah laws and rules
topical_requirements.quote: completing at least one hour of continuing professional education that covers this chapter and Utah Administrative Code, R156-26a, Utah Certified Public Accountant Licensing Act Rule; and completing at least three hours of ethics education that cover one or more of the following areas: the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct; case-based instruction focusing on real-life situational learning; ethical dilemmas faced by accounting professionals; or business ethics

available.quote: The division may issue a license under this chapter to an individual who holds a license as a certified public accountant issued by another state

requirements.value: Applicant must show evidence of passing qualifying examinations and either meet requirements applicable at time of original licensure or have 4 years professional experience within 10 years preceding application, or show substantially equivalent education, examination, and experience
requirements.quote:
(I) shows evidence of having passed the qualifying examinations; and
(II)
(Aa) meets the requirements for licensure which were applicable in this state at the time of the issuance of the applicant's license by the state from which the original licensure by satisfactorily passing the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination was issued; or
(Bb) had four years of professional experience after passing the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination upon which the original license was based, within the 10 years immediately preceding the application for licensure by endorsement; or
(B) shows evidence that the applicant's education, examination record, and experience are substantially equivalent to the requirements of Subsection (1), as provided by rule.

exists.quote: Board means the Utah Board of Accountancy created in Section 58-26a-201

national_certification.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: AICPA means the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

regulatory_model.quote: A license is required for an individual to engage in the practice of public accounting

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue to an individual who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of Certified Public Accountant

is_mandatory.quote: A license is required for an individual to engage in the practice of public accounting, except as specifically provided in Section 58-26a-305 or 58-1-307

title_protection.quote: using "certified public accountant," "public accountant," "CPA," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless that person: has a current license as a certified public accountant issued under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: except as provided in Section 58-26a-305, engaging in the following conduct if not licensed under this chapter to practice public accountancy: issuing a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using CPA title or designation without proper licensure or exemption
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using "certified public accountant," "public accountant," "CPA," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless that person: has a current license as a certified public accountant issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Firm using CPA designation without proper registration of all offices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a firm assuming or using "certified public accountant," "CPA," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the firm is composed of certified public accountants unless each office of the firm in this state: is registered with the division

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing accounting or financial statements without proper licensure and office registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: signing or affixing to any accounting or financial statement the person's name or any trade or assumed name used in that person's profession or business, with any wording indicating that the person is an auditor, or with any wording indicating that the person has expert knowledge in accounting or auditing, unless that person is licensed under this chapter and all of the person's offices in this state for the practice of public accountancy are maintained and registered as provided in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing reports on financial statements or using attest language without licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: except as provided in Section 58-26a-305, engaging in the following conduct if not licensed under this chapter to practice public accountancy: issuing a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit; or issuing a report using any form of language substantially similar to conventional language used by licensees respecting: a review of financial statements; or a compilation of financial statements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking engagement knowing licensee cannot complete it with professional competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: undertaking an engagement when the licensee knows or should know that the licensee could not reasonably expect to complete it with professional competence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business creating conflict of interest without full disclosure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in any business or activity that creates a conflict of interest with a licensee's practice in the profession when the licensee knows or should know that it is a conflict of interest and the licensee does not fully disclose the conflict of interest in writing to all affected parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet continuing education or peer review requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to meet the requirements for continuing professional education or peer review required under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing report or performing attest engagement without independence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a client, other than a report in which a lack of independence is disclosed, or performing an attest engagement subject to the attestation standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants when the licensee is not independent, in fact and appearance, to the client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving commission when performing audit, review, or compilation services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee may not, for a commission, recommend or refer to a client a product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer a product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee also performs for that client: an audit or review of a financial statement; a compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence; or an examination of prospective financial information

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing services for contingent fee when also performing attest or compilation services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee may not: perform for a contingent fee a professional service for, or receive a contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: an audit or review of a financial statement; a compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence; or an examination of prospective financial information; or prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for a client

definition_quote.value: Practice of public accounting means, while holding oneself out as a certified public accountant, offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client
definition_quote.quote: Practice of public accounting means, while holding oneself out as a certified public accountant, offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client

methods_authorized.quote: offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client

value: audit or other engagement in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
review of financial statement in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)
examination of prospective financial information in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
engagement in accordance with standards of the PCAOB
attest_services_types.quote: Attest and attestation engagement means providing any or all of the following services: an audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); a review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); an examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); an examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE), other than an examination described in Subsection (3)(a)(iii); or an engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Compilation means providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presenting, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management or owners, without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: demonstrate completion of at least a bachelor's degree or the equivalent as described in Subsection 58-26a-302(1)(c)

ethics_exam_required.quote: the AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a person who qualifies under Subsection (1)(a) has all the privileges of a licensee of this state and may engage in acts included within the definition of the practice of public accountancy, whether in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means, based on a practice privilege in this state, and no notice, fee, or other submission shall be provided by that person

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the division
comply with this chapter and the rules made under this chapter
cease offering or rendering professional services in this state if license from principal place of business becomes invalid
appointment of the state board which issued the person's license as the person's agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: the person consents, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the division; to comply with this chapter and the rules made under this chapter; that in the event the license from the state of the person's principal place of business becomes invalid, the person shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state both individually and on behalf of the firm; and to the appointment of the state board which issued the person's license as the person's agent upon whom process may be served in an action or proceeding brought by the division against the licensee

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: Registration with the division is required for a qualified business entity to engage in the practice of public accounting

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: have, notwithstanding any other provision of law, a simple majority of the ownership of the Certified Public Accountant firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, held by individuals who are certified public accountants, licensed under this chapter or another state of the United States of America

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A Certified Public Accountant firm may include owners who are not licensed under this chapter as outlined in Subsection (3)(a)(iii), provided that: the firm designates a licensee of this state who is responsible for the proper registration of the Certified Public Accountant firm and identifies that individual to the division; and all nonlicensed owners are active individual participants in the CPA firm

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: At the time of renewal a licensee shall show satisfactory evidence of each of the following renewal requirements: completion of qualified continuing education as required under Section 58-26a-304; and successful completion of a peer review meeting the requirements established by rule by the division in collaboration with the board

retired_license_status_available.quote: A person currently licensed as a certified public accountant may, on any renewal date of that license, apply for and obtain a transfer of that license to a status of CPA emeritus registration

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in the practice of public accountancy

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a licensee under this chapter, incident to or in the course of professional service to a client, are the property of the licensee, in the absence of any express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee may not, for a commission, recommend or refer to a client a product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer a product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee also performs for that client: an audit or review of a financial statement; a compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence; or an examination of prospective financial information

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee may not: perform for a contingent fee a professional service for, or receive a contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: an audit or review of a financial statement; a compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence; or an examination of prospective financial information; or prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for a client

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Report does not include a financial statement prepared by an unlicensed person if: that financial statement has a cover page which includes essentially the following language: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying financial statements of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended. This presentation is limited to preparing, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management (owners). I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Registration with the division is required for a qualified business entity to engage in the practice of public accounting

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: A person currently licensed as a certified public accountant may, on any renewal date of that license, apply for and obtain a transfer of that license to a status of CPA emeritus registration

ethics_cpe_hours_required.quote: completing at least three hours of ethics education that cover one or more of the following areas: the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct; case-based instruction focusing on real-life situational learning; ethical dilemmas faced by accounting professionals; or business ethics

liability_privity_limitation.quote: A licensee, a CPA firm registered under this chapter, and any employee, partner, member, officer, or shareholder of a licensee or CPA firm are not liable to persons with whom they are not in privity of contract for civil damages resulting from acts, omissions, decisions, or other conduct in connection with professional services performed by that person, except for: acts, omissions, decisions, or conduct that constitute fraud or intentional misrepresentations; or other acts, omissions, decisions, or conduct, if the person performing the professional services: knew that a primary intent of the client was for the professional services to benefit or influence the particular person seeking to establish liability; and identified in writing to the client that the professional services performed on behalf of the client were intended to be relied upon by the particular person seeking to establish liability

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a client, other than a report in which a lack of independence is disclosed, or performing an attest engagement subject to the attestation standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants when the licensee is not independent, in fact and appearance, to the client
